name: Hahnenkamm Reutte
kurzbeschreibung: The Hahnenkamm peak at 1,938 metres above Reutte in the Tannheim Mountains delights hikers with the Reutte gondola, sensory barefoot trails, and valley vistas.
preis: Hiking area and barefoot trails freely accessible; Hahnenkammbahn cable car charges apply
oeffnungszeiten: Summer cable car operations daily mid-May to late October, 08:30 to 16:30
beschreibung:
Überblick

The prominent Hahnenkamm near Reutte (1,938 metres) rises as the iconic local summit of the Naturparkregion Reutte within the rugged Tannheim Mountains in the Tyrolean Außerfern. Celebrated as one of Western Tirol's most accessible panoramic viewpoints, the limestone massif affords unobstructed vistas overlooking the wide valley basin of Reutte, the wild turquoise braided loops of the Lech River, and the jagged spires of the Lechtal and Allgäu Alps. A modern gondola whisks hikers, botanical enthusiasts, and families from the village of Höfen up to the Höfener Älpele mountain station at 1,730 metres in minutes. At the top terminal, an engaging alpine experience awaits: the famous high-altitude barefoot trail revitalizes tired feet on alpine turf, while a curated alpine botanical garden showcases indigenous flora. Welcoming alpine lodges with wide sundecks invite guests to savor authentic Tyrolean delicacies surrounded by grazing cattle.

Route & Anforderungen

A versatile array of graded mountain paths spreads outward from the mountain gondola station. An undisputed favorite for families and wellness seekers is the two-kilometre barefoot sensory circuit around the Höfener Älpele, leading across eighteen distinct tactile stations featuring wood bark, river pebbles, peat pools, and ice-cold spring channels (approx. one hour walk). Fit hikers can ascend from the lift station in roughly 45 minutes along an engineered panoramic ridge to the main summit cross of the Hahnenkamm (1,938 metres), rewarded with views spanning towards the Zugspitze. Sneakers suffice for the barefoot trail, whereas supportive hiking boots with rubber vibram soles are required for climbing the rocky summit ridge toward Gaichtspitze or Schneetalalm.

Besuch & Anreise

Travel by road is toll-free from Füssen or Kempten along highway B179 into Reutte, following provincial signs toward Höfen and the Hahnenkammbahn bottom terminal. Sprawling free car parking is located on site. Rail passengers take the scenic Außerfernbahn line to Reutte in Tirol station and transfer directly to synchronized regional VVT buses stopping right in front of the lift station.

Tipps

Walk the sensory trail completely barefoot: stepping through cool mountain peat and crystalline spring water stimulates foot reflexology zones and refreshes the whole body. Afterward, dine on Tyrolean Gröstl hash at the panoramic sundeck restaurant while watching colorful paragliders take off from the grassy ridge.
